exec git init -b main
at 2026-07-20T12:00:00Z
exec card init --prefix summary-
exec sh -c 'printf "version: 1\nissue:\n  id:\n    prefix: summary-\n    strategy: sequential\n" > .cardamom/config.yaml'

exec card create --summary 'Keep the contract concise.' --details 'Expanded **design** material.' 'Document summary fields'
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/create.txt

exec card --json show summary-1
cmpjson stdout $WORK/golden/show.json

# The configured maximum counts UTF-8 bytes and does not constrain details.
exec sh -c 'printf "version: 1\nissue:\n  id:\n    prefix: summary-\n    strategy: sequential\n  summary:\n    max_bytes: 4\n" > .cardamom/config.yaml'
! exec card create --summary 'ééé' 'Too many bytes'
cmp stderr $WORK/golden/utf8-error.txt
exec sh -c 'details=$(head -c 4096 /dev/zero | tr "\000" x); card create --summary Tiny --details "$details" "Large details"'
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/create-details.txt

# Every operation that supplies a summary uses the shared domain limit.
! exec card edit summary-1 --summary '12345'
cmp stderr $WORK/golden/five-byte-error.txt
! exec card apply oversized.json
cmp stderr $WORK/golden/apply-error.txt
! exec card apply oversized-update.json
cmp stderr $WORK/golden/apply-error.txt
! exec card apply oversized-group.json
cmp stderr $WORK/golden/group-error.txt

# A summary accepted under a larger limit remains valid after the limit drops
# when an unrelated field changes.
exec sh -c 'printf "version: 1\nissue:\n  id:\n    prefix: summary-\n    strategy: sequential\n  summary:\n    max_bytes: 4096\n" > .cardamom/config.yaml'
exec sh -c 'summary=$(head -c 3000 /dev/zero | tr "\000" x); card create --summary "$summary" "Existing large summary"'
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/create-existing.txt
exec sh -c 'printf "version: 1\nissue:\n  id:\n    prefix: summary-\n    strategy: sequential\n  summary:\n    max_bytes: 4\n" > .cardamom/config.yaml'
exec card edit summary-3 --priority 1
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/edit-existing.txt

# Normal editing and apply carry summary and details together.
exec card edit summary-1 --summary 'Edit' --details 'Edited details.'
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/edit.txt
exec card apply valid.json
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/apply.txt
exec card --json show summary-4
cmpjson stdout $WORK/golden/applied-show.json

# Human show and claim output disclose selected details. Ancestors inherit only
# summary and state while advertising expanded details by UTF-8 byte count.
exec card state set summary-5 'Parent recovery state.'
exec card create --parent summary-5 --summary 'Leaf' --details 'Leaf details.' 'Leaf issue'
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/create-leaf.txt
exec card show summary-1
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/human-show.txt
exec card --actor worker claim summary-6 --context
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/claim.txt

exec card dump dump --issue summary-1 --no-descendants
cmp dump/issues/summary-1.md $WORK/golden/dump.md

# Skip policy does not validate input that will not replace stored metadata.
exec card apply oversized-skip.json
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/apply-skip.txt
